canvas.units: pixels (design size equals canvas size, camera at rest)
canvas.background: transparent; results are premultiplied RGBA in 0..1

images.checker16: 16 x 16 RGBA8, texel (i, j) is #e8e4daff when (i + j) is even and #1b2a4aff otherwise; bilinear, clamp to edge, texel centres at (i + 0.5) / 16

semantics: SVG 1.1 and Canvas 2D: nonzero or even-odd fills; a stroke is the union of each segment's rectangle, its joins (miter with limit, falling back to bevel; round; bevel) and its caps (butt, round, square); dashes start at the contour start, lengths in user units; zero-length dashes draw their caps; gradients interpolate unpremultiplied colour linearly in the given values, pad outside 0..1; a clip multiplies coverage by the clip path's fill coverage.
reference: web/motion/vector_ref.mjs, on the CPU in Node: coverage from 16 x 16 point samples per pixel of the exact region (fills by winding number at each sample; strokes by point-in-piece tests on the stroke's segments, joins and caps); paint evaluated at the pixel centre and multiplied by coverage.

bounds.metric: absolute difference per channel of premultiplied RGBA, GPU against the CPU reference

interior.where: pixels the reference covers fully (all 256 samples) and that lie at least 1.5 px from every edge sample
interior.why: paint only: 2/255 for gradient and image filtering precision

edge.where: all other pixels where either image has coverage
edge.why: the GPU ramps coverage over signed distance (one pixel wide); against box-filtered coverage that is exact for axis-aligned edges and within about 0.043 for straight edges at 45 degrees. Sharp corners lose more

sharp.why: miter tips and star points narrower than a pixel, where distance ramping and box coverage differ most

outside.where: pixels the reference does not cover and at least 1.5 px from every edge sample

cases.about: self-intersecting star, nonzero winding
the same star, even-odd: the centre pentagon is a hole
a pentagon, the plain case
zigzag, round joins and caps (the existing stroke)
zigzag, miter joins within the limit, butt caps
one join past miter limit 2 falls back to bevel, square caps
zigzag, bevel joins, square caps
closed pentagon stroke: miter joins all round, no caps
flattened cubic wave, butt caps, round joins
one-pixel stroke
circle (as a path) with dashes 24 on, 12 off, offset 6, butt caps
zero-length dashes with round caps: dots every 20 units
rectangle, linear gradient with three stops
pentagon, radial gradient, transparent edge
wave stroke painted with a linear gradient
a filled rectangle clipped by a circle
linear gradient clipped by the even-odd star
a dashed stroke clipped by a rectangle
pentagon filled with a 16 x 16 checker image stretched over 0..256, bilinear
zigzag stroke painted with the checker image

does_not_prove: Agreement on these twenty cases at this size. Not every SVG feature (no stroke transforms, no gradient spread modes other than pad, no pattern repeat), and not the look against another renderer.
